profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Sherpa 6, Inc.
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with a background in Software Development, Systems Engineering, and Project Management. For over 15 years, my focus has been Model-Based Systems Engineering and Software Development using C/C++. More recently I have worked with client / server communications and server backend using NodeJS.

Specialties: Software Engineering – Software Development – Programming – System Engineering – Systems Engineering – Project Management – Cross-Functional Leadership

positions.title: Backend Development Manager
positions.description: Manage day to day activities within the Backend Development group. Promote inter- and intra-group communication and transparency. Contribute to backend code design and development.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software developer working with C/C++, NodeJS, Client / Server interfaces, server backend.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software developer working with C/C++, client / server communications, threads, KMIP

positions.title: Project Manager, Software Developer
positions.description: Project Manager and Software Developer offering expertise in Earned Value Management, Modeling and Simulation, Object Oriented Design, and Systems Engineering.

positions.title: Project Manager - Weapon System Engineering
positions.description: Led design and development team for tactical Weapon System Computer Program Product. Coordinated Model-Based Design Engineering and oversaw System Engineering process, from derivation of system design via modeling and analysis, to A Specification and B Specification development and flow-down, to Engineering Technical Reviews of Specifications, to Engineering Test and Evaluation of the tactical Computer Program, and finally to Computer Program Build deployment. Functioned as the project Earned Value Manager, reporting cost, schedule, and technical status. Identified and mitigated risks.

positions.title: Advanced Technical Leadership Program
positions.description:
Rotational leadership development program. Performed the following six to nine month roles:

Deputy Program Manager - coordinated computer lab upgrade including hardware and software updates. Developed installation schedule, budget, and identified risks to on-time delivery.

Lab Transition Lead - coordinated transfer of computer training lab from San Diego facility to customer location. Worked with cross-functional team with members from Hardware, Software, Network, ILS, Procurement, Configuration Management, Quality, Finance, and the Program Management team.

Test and Evaluation Engineer - performed testing of C4ISR system in both lab and shipyard environments. Initiated two process improvement activities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop, debug, and refactor simulation model of tactical computer program. Build standalone models of tactical functions to enable testing. Track code changes with rigorous configuration management. Code B5 Specifications into simulation to expand modeling capabilities. Work with the High Level Architecture to build distributed simulations with target, missile, and ship federates.

positions.title: Project Manager - Systems Analysis
positions.description: Led the Systems Analysis Integrated Product Team in performance analysis of tactical computer program using high fidelity modeling and simulation. Interfaced with the Program Office and technical leadership to accomplish scope defined in the Statement of Work.
